sara_devex: Flagging a parity bug between REST quickstarts and SDK behavior — customers on Private hit two issues: auth header mismatch and different retry/timeout semantics. Repro below.

bob_sdk: Which SDKs and endpoints?

sara_devex: Node 0.8.2 and Go 0.7.9, endpoints: POST /v1/embeddings and POST /v1/generate. Problem A = Private control plane requires X-Redwood-API-Key instead of Authorization: Bearer (SDK always sends Bearer). Problem B = REST examples show retry_on + timeout_ms fields; SDK exposes retries + timeout (seconds) and interprets 429 differently.

carlos_infra: Oof. Private installs sometimes flip expected header for compliance. If SDK always sends Authorization, control plane can 401 even if key is valid under X-Redwood-API-Key.

sara_devex: Repro curl that works against our private sandbox:
```bash
curl -X POST 'https://private.local/redwood/v1/embeddings' \
  -H 'X-Redwood-API-Key: $API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"embed-small","input":"hello","retry_on":[429],"timeout_ms":12000}'
```

sara_devex: Equivalent Node SDK call per docs (what customers try):
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.API_KEY });
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'embed-small', input: 'hello', retries: 2, timeout: 12 });
```

sara_devex: Observed diffs: 1) curl with X-Redwood-API-Key -> 200; SDK with Authorization header -> 401. 2) curl uses retry_on/timeout_ms and will retry on 429; SDK's retries only apply to HTTP 5xx by default, and timeout is enforced differently (seconds vs ms) causing premature cancellation.

devon_qa: I ran a trace: SDK emitted `Authorization: Bearer` and server responded with `401` + header `x-expected-api-header: X-Redwood-API-Key`. After swapping header names in SDK config, the call proceeds but 429 responses are surfaced instead of being retried.

bob_sdk: Thanks for the repro. Two related but separable bugs: (A) SDK should allow customizing header name (apiKeyHeaderName) and detect server hint headers to give actionable error messages. (B) Retry semantics: we have an internal decision to not auto-retry 429 for streaming endpoints; embedding/generation non-streaming calls should treat 429 as retryable by default or at least honor server `retry_on` metadata. Also unify ms vs s timeout naming to avoid off-by-factor issues.

tara_docs: Our quickstart currently shows `retries` and `timeout` in SDK snippets, and `retry_on`/`timeout_ms` in REST examples — that's confusing. I'll consolidate to a single canonical sample and add a Private note with X-Redwood-API-Key.

sara_devex: Interim workaround suggestion for Node customers: pass explicit header config and retry policy: 
```js
const client = new Redwood({
  apiKey: process.env.API_KEY,
  apiKeyHeaderName: 'X-Redwood-API-Key',
  retryOn: [429, 503],
  timeoutMs: 15000
});
await client.embeddings.create(...)
```

bob_sdk: I'll implement: - new constructor option `apiKeyHeaderName` (defaults to `Authorization`), - honor `retry_on` + `max_retries` when present in request body/response metadata, - treat 429 as retryable for non-stream calls, - accept both `timeout` (s) and `timeoutMs` for backwards compat and normalize internally.

carlos_infra: On the infra side we'll add a server-side hint header `x-expected-api-header` (already present in repro) and a metric when clients send unexpected headers so we can surface install-level guidance to support.

devon_qa: I'll add regression tests: compare curl vs SDK for these flows: success, 429->retry->success, 503/backoff, 401 with missing header hint. I'll attach cassettes. Ticket: DEVEX-1901 created.

bob_sdk: Filing SDK issue and PR now, aiming for rc this week. I'll include unit tests for both Node and Go SDKs and an integration canary against private staging.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: sdk/node v0.8.3-rc2 -> canary at 2026-03-23T09:30:00Z :rocket: 

tara_docs: I'll update quickstart and add a Troubleshooting section: "401 on Private? Try apiKeyHeaderName: 'X-Redwood-API-Key'" and a note on `retry_on` vs SDK `retryOn` mapping.

sara_devex: Great, thanks. Can we also add a tiny blurb in the onboarding flow to show the header difference for Private installs? Saves customers from a painful first-run. :pray:

bob_sdk: yep, added to PR description + changelog. Will ping here when rc is up.

sara_devex: Closing loop for now. Will validate once RC is promoted. Thanks everyone!
